title: dateStamp
summary: Copies today’s date in the format you choose.
about: Copies today’s date to the clipboard from its menu or a keyboard shortcut, as 2026-11-08, 8 November 2026 or 20261108-1530. Other plugins can ask it for the date too.

settings.title: Show a notice
settings.description: Under the icon, when the date is copied.
